description: Red stroke, that starts a third of the way up the left side of the paper, curls in and continues vertical, stopping before the edge of the paper. Another red stroke begins in the middle of the curve of the first stroke and curves downward, and then continues to the edge of the paper. A singular red circle is in the middle of the paper, above the red curving stroke.
